fmug2e6ed.name: Roanoke Security Mission
fmug2e6ed.desc: A detachment of Fennec Marines deployed to secure a holding for the displaced Fennec people currently traveling by boat from the Eurasian region.

fmug2j250.name: Tennessee Federative Republic
fmug2j250.desc: An unstable republic with a joint military-civil constitution that may cause problems down the line. Remnants of the old American parties and a hateful military that seeks revenge against the communists.

fmug2ph3r.name: Moscow Republic
fmug2ph3r.desc: Moscow initially emerged as a liberal republic after the collapse of the old Russian government. By 1975, however, the liberals had been overthrown and a communist government had taken power.
